description: Get the full public details of one live listing by its id: title, price, description, seller, reviews and how to buy it. Use search_listings first if you don't have an id. Only returns live listings; use my_account to see your own drafts and pending listings. No API key needed.

id.description: Listing id, e.g. "X-hZ2AxkOc-B": the id field from search_listings, my_account or create_listing

name: get_listing
title: Get a listing
